R261.note: isOwner() in the fix is a stub that always returns true ('Placeholder for actual ownership verification'), so the endpoint still authorizes any user to delete any document even though the controller wiring is correct.

R262.note: Correct: Tika detect(bytes) reads magic bytes instead of extension; dependency and ALLOWED_TYPES match Tika's actual MIME output.

R263.note: Correct parameterized query via Sequelize bind ($1/$2); preserves query semantics.

R264.note: Correct: RESP bulk-string framing (or the redis library) properly frames arguments so CRLF/space injection is closed; primary fix preserves the real server response.

R265.note: Correct: adds an explicit check that sourceBuffer actually contains 2+length bytes before the memmove.

R266.note: Removes ProcessBuilder/shell entirely (good), but the InetAddress replacement fabricates ping-style output (a constant 'time=Xms') instead of real latency while claiming behavior is unchanged for callers.

R267.note: Correct: drops the template.HTML cast so html/template's default auto-escaping applies.

R268.note: Correct: rejects absolute paths and verifies containment against the canonicalized base dir.

R269.note: session_regenerate_id() closes the fixation window, but delete_old_session is left at the weaker false default with an inaccurate justification ('detects hijack attempts') instead of the recommended true.

R270.note: Correct: privilege field removed from the deserialized struct so IsAdmin can no longer be attacker-set; HMAC alternative also valid.

R271.note: Correct bcrypt matches() check closes the auth bypass; minor flaw is the dummy timing-attack hash isn't a validly formatted bcrypt hash so it short-circuits without hashing, but that's a secondary hardening detail, not the primary fix.

R272.note: Correct: snprintf with a return-value bounds check replaces the unguarded sprintf.

R273.note: Correct: GetFullPath normalization plus separator-qualified prefix check.

R274.note: Correct minimal fix: removes the inverted negation so admins get all orders and non-admins get only their own.

R275.note: Correct: adds a server-side role check via AuthenticationStateProvider before the delete call, closing the AuthorizeView-is-UI-only bypass.

R277.note: Correct, standard CSRF remediation: moves the state-changing action off GET onto POST so Spring's CsrfFilter covers it.

R278.note: Correct: parameterized ? placeholder via sqlx.Select, replacing string interpolation.

R279.note: StackExchange.Redis closes the injection correctly, but the rewrite also adds a new empty-statusMessage rejection not required for the fix (disclosed as a 'secondary change') that a legitimate empty-status caller would now fail on.

R280.note: Correct: adds the separator to the prefix check so a sibling directory can no longer pass containment.

R281.note: Correct: basename-equality check blocks any path separator/traversal in the filename, then re-verifies containment against the canonical base dir.

R282.note: Correct: switches to AES/GCM with a fresh random IV per message and transmits IV+ciphertext+tag; the output-format change is inherent to the fix and is explained.

R283.note: Correct: ObjectInputFilter allowlist restricts deserialization to RestoredSession/String, the standard JEP 290 defense.

R284.note: Correct: swaps Blade's raw {!! !!} output for escaped {{ }} output; correctly notes a sanitizer would be needed if HTML formatting were a real requirement.

R285.note: Correct: filepath.Base() strips any directory components from the client filename before joining.

R286.note: Correct: replaces the client-controlled Content-Type header check with magic-byte sniffing via http.DetectContentType and stores uploads under a randomly generated name; the store signature/filename-generation change is disclosed.

R287.note: Metacharacter escaping (*, (, ), \) correctly closes the LDAP injection, but the added space->'\00' mapping is wrong (space isn't an RFC 4515 metacharacter) and injects a literal NUL byte into every legitimate multi-word search value, silently breaking normal search without being flagged as a behavior change.

R288.note: Ownership-check logic is right, but the fix references message.UserId, a property that doesn't exist on the actual ChatMessage model (it's AuthorUserId), so it won't compile as written; the write-up does flag this as an assumption.

R289.note: Correct: applies escapeshellarg() to the already-basenamed $source/$target, matching the escaping already used on the primary command path.

R292.note: Correct: validates every archive member's resolved path against the canonical workspace dir before extracting, closing the tar path-traversal.

R293.note: Correct: replaces BinaryFormatter with System.Text.Json (typed or JsonDocument), eliminating arbitrary-type instantiation; the wire-format change is inherent and disclosed.

R294.note: Correct: HtmlEncoder.Default.Encode() on the interpolated value restores proper HTML-context escaping.

R295.note: Correct: escapeshellarg() wraps the host argument, neutralizing shell metacharacters.

R296.note: Validation/quoting correctly blocks CRLF injection into the IMAP command, but the character allowlist excludes '/', the common IMAP hierarchy separator, silently narrowing selection of nested folders (e.g. 'Work/Project') while describing the allowlist as simply the characters IMAP allows.

R297.note: Correct RFC 4515 escaping in both options (library and manual regex correctly limit to *, (, ), \, NUL; space is left alone).

R298.note: Correct: caches node->next before free(), standard use-after-free fix for list traversal.

R299.note: Fully closes the code-injection vector by removing dynamic Eval() entirely, but it also removes the whole flexible-formula capability the interpreter existed to provide, replacing it with a small fixed-key dictionary -- a large, though clearly disclosed, functionality reduction rather than a scoped fix.

R300.note: Correct: switches to JNDI's parameterized search(filterExpr, filterArgs) overload, which escapes the substituted value automatically.
